Pete Hegseth's spectacle last Thursday should be enough to warrant his removal
as secretary of defense in and of itself. In a ranting
[video](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/05/us/politics/hegseth-video-midterms-
trump.html) posted on social media in response to reporting on his potential
impeachment, Hegseth once again put his violent extremism, emotional
instability, and psychological volatility on full display as he made direct
overtures threatening the use of the U.S. military against his political
enemies. Or, as he calls them, "the radical Democrats."

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Most of us knew a Hegseth tenure would be catastrophic. Now, a year and a half
in, it's been far worse than I predicted in March last year when I publicly
blew the whistle on his unlawful
[dismantling](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-
security/2025/03/04/trump-hegseth-pentagon-firings-civilian-
harm/?fbclid=IwY2xjawI2nv9leHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHS5sj5M6CpU_s2kbZOwXWQrhALQDLEYw5dm0qcmc4NqqbdYiG50UCjORUA_aem_CvGGm_WdV_G0N-zbJxufPA)
of the Pentagon's civilian protection center, where I served as chief of
civilian harm assessments, and raised
[alarms](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2025/03/04/opinion/trump-hegseth-
pentagon-diversity-military/) about his ideology and character.

With [Pete Hegseth](https://zeteo.com/p/secretary-of-war-crimes-pete-hegseth)
at the helm of the most powerful military in history, under the free rein
given to him by Donald Trump, the United States has come to embody far-right
fascism and the pursuit of global
[domination](https://www.whitehouse.gov/releases/2026/09/president-trump-at-
the-united-nations-while-others-have-talked-i-have-acted/) - economically,
politically, and militarily.

While Hegseth's proclaimed
[mantra](https://media.defense.gov/2026/Jan/23/2003864773/-1/-1/0/2026-national-
defense-strategy.pdf) has been "Peace through Strength," the reality played
out before the world has been _Submission through Tyranny_. Under this
administration, the United States has sought nothing less than submission -
from our adversaries, from our allies, and from the American people, with
Hegseth wielding the U.S. military as his primary instrument of enforcement.
